meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装好后,给 Claude 一张 224×224 的 H&E 组织切块和基因符号列表,它会输出这些基因的 log1p-CPM 空间表达值并按网格排布;支持约 19,000 个蛋白编码基因,整张切片可切块后批量预测。
howto.when: 当需要从 H&E 切片得到 224×224、约 20 倍下的 log1p-CPM 空间基因表达,按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或对整张切片做预测时。

say.text: 用 DeepSpot-M 预测这个切块的 EPCAM、CD3D 表达。
say.note: 会返回这两个基因的 log1p-CPM 值。

say.text: 把这张全切片裁成 224×224 切块,预测全转录组。
say.note: 输出按切块网格排布的基因表达矩阵。

say.text: 换用 evo2 嵌入,重跑这些切块的基因预测。
say.note: 结果来自基因组序列视角。

howto.what_en: Given a 224x224 H&E tile and gene symbols, DeepSpot-M returns log1p-CPM spatial expression for those genes, arranged on the tile grid. It supports ~19k protein-coding genes, and can process a whole slide after tiling.
howto.when_en: Use when you need log1p-CPM spatial expression for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this tile with DeepSpot-M.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values for those genes.

say_en.text: Tile this whole slide into 224x224 patches and predict the transcriptome.
say_en.note: Output is a gene-expression matrix on the tile grid.

say_en.text: Rerun these tiles with the evo2 embedding source.
